dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: Haha, so you overheard me just now? My apologies, I was merely wondering how best to promote my new dish. After all, the Epic Feast Showdown is about to begin!

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: Calling it "legendary" might be going a little too far, but I'm not sure what else I can say...
